svg.title: Microsoft's Responsible AI Principles
svg.desc: Hub diagram. Responsible AI sits at the centre with six principles around it. Fairness: no discrimination by race, gender, age or disability. Reliability and safety: works consistently, fails predictably and safely. Privacy and security: personal data and systems are protected from attack and misuse. Inclusiveness: benefits everyone regardless of ability or background. Transparency: users understand AI decisions. Accountability: humans remain responsible for AI outcomes.
svg.text: Six principles, one standard: every AI use case is checked against all of them.
